name: longPress
description: Performs a long press (press and hold) gesture on an element for the specified duration. This typically triggers context menus, enables drag-and-drop mode, or activates editing modes depending on the app's behavior. The default duration of 1000ms (1 second) works for most apps, but you can adjust it if needed.

elementId.description: Element identifier to long press on (from findElement)

durationMs.description: How long to hold the press in milliseconds (default: 1000). Increase if the app requires longer presses to trigger the desired action
